## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue with `Fixes` when fully resolved, or `Refs` for partial work and proposals.

## Validation

List checks actually run, their environment and results. State untested behavior and compatibility changes.

## Merge and acceptance

State whether this is a simple fix or requires user acceptance. For lifecycle, format, public API or gameplay changes, include manual steps and expected results. Do not enable auto-merge while waiting for user acceptance.
